name: Aid
description: Your blessing bolsters up to three creatures: each one's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for 8 hours. Each higher slot raises the bonus by 5.

name: Blindness/Deafness
description: You rob one creature of a sense: Constitution save or it is blinded or deafened (your choice) for a minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Each higher slot afflicts one more creature.

name: Branding Smite
description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack during the spell, the attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage, and the target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and cannot benefit from invisibility until the spell ends. Higher slots add 1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Calm Emotions
description: You settle a crowd's spirit: each humanoid in a 20-foot sphere makes a Charisma save or has any charm or fright effect on it suppressed, or is made indifferent to creatures it was hostile toward (unless attacked).

name: Darkness
description: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot sphere that even darkvision cannot pierce and nonmagical light cannot brighten. Cast it on a small object and carry the darkness with you, covering the object to shut it off.

name: Enhance Ability
description: You touch a creature and choose an ability score; for up to an hour it has advantage on ability checks using that score. Each higher slot touches one more creature.

name: Hold Person
description: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Attacks against a paralyzed creature have advantage, and hits from within 5 feet are automatic criticals. Each higher slot targets one more humanoid.

name: Invisibility
description: A creature you touch vanishes from sight until it attacks, casts a spell, or your concentration ends. Each higher slot hides one additional creature.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: As a bonus action, your touch ends one condition afflicting a creature — blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

name: Locate Object
description: You sense the direction to an object you name — a specific one you have seen up close, or a kind of object — so long as it is within 1,000 feet. A thin sheet of lead blocks the sense entirely.

name: Misty Step
description: Briefly veiled in silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see — the classic bonus-action escape.

name: Moonbeam
description: A silvery beam of moonlight, 5 feet wide and 40 feet tall, shines down where you point. A creature that enters the beam or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 radiant damage on a failure (half on a success), and shapechangers save at disadvantage and revert. You can move the beam 60 feet as a Magic action.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: A 10-minute prayer restores up to five creatures: each regains 2d8 hit points (no modifier added) and also gains the benefit of a short rest. Each higher slot adds 1d8 healing.

name: Scorching Ray
description: Three rays of fire streak at targets of your choice, each a separate ranged spell attack dealing 2d6 fire damage on a hit. Each higher slot creates one additional ray.

name: Shatter
description: A sudden ringing noise like a struck bell erupts in a 10-foot sphere: Constitution save or 3d8 thunder damage (half on a success). Creatures of crystal, stone, or metal save at disadvantage, and loose objects take the damage too. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

name: Silence
description: A 20-foot sphere of absolute silence: no sound can be created in or pass through it, creatures fully inside are immune to thunder damage, and verbal spellcasting is impossible there. Often cast as a ritual against enemy casters.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: A floating weapon of force — often your deity's favored arm — appears and strikes on a melee spell attack for 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier force damage; as a bonus action you can move it 20 feet and strike again. Requires concentration. Higher slots raise the damage every two levels.

name: Suggestion
description: You suggest a course of activity of up to 25 words, phrased to sound reasonable: Wisdom save or the charmed creature pursues it to the best of its ability. The spell ends if you or allies damage the target.

name: Warding Bond
description: You and a willing creature, each wearing one of a pair of platinum rings, are mystically linked: it gains +1 AC and saving throws and resistance to all damage — and every point of damage it takes, you take too.

name: Web
description: Thick, sticky webbing fills a 20-foot cube, lightly obscuring it and making difficult terrain. Creatures starting there or entering make Dexterity saves or are restrained until they break free with a Strength check; the webs are flammable — burning webbing deals 2d4 fire damage to a creature that starts its turn in the fire.
